hero.sub_1: A fantasy 3D action adventure you can jump into instantly — no build homework, just cast, dodge, and push forward.
hero.sub_2: Become a wizard of light and rescue Princess Torosso from the prison island.
hero.video_label: Gameplay footage: combat across grass, volcano, ice and desert

trailer.h2: Thirty seconds is all it takes.
trailer.lead: Magic combat, obstacle runs, boss fights — see it in real gameplay.

loop.h2: Slay the target. The gate opens.
loop.lead: No build research. Aim, clear, beat the boss, break through — the flow never stops until the ending.

steps.body: Fight the incoming waves with ranged magic.
steps.alt: Casting magic at a crowd of enemies on a grass field

steps.title: Clear the target, open the gate
steps.body: Defeat the designated enemies and the next gate opens.
steps.alt: A castle gate opening after the objective is cleared

steps.title: Beat the boss
steps.body: A boss waits at the end of every chapter.

steps.title: Break through

steps.alt: Climbing a wooden structure on a cliff

magic.lead: Projectile and Area spells grow stronger as you stack cards; Summon and Shield trigger the moment you pick them up.

cards.name: Projectile
cards.body: Pressure single targets from range. Every hit refills mana.

cards.name: Area
cards.body: Spend stored mana to wipe a whole crowd at once.

cards.name: Summon
cards.body: Pick up the card and an ally joins the fight instantly.

cards.name: Shield
cards.body: Block incoming damage and survive the push.

magic.mana: land basic hits to recover mana, then unleash an area blast. There is no build to study.

traverse.h2: After every fight, the road changes.
traverse.lead: Every chapter ends with an obstacle section that changes how you move — jump, ride, time it right, and reach the next region.
traverse.hover_hint: Hover a tile to play the clip.

story.h2: In a world where the bloodlines of light and darkness still remain.
p: An arrogant imperial prince proposes to Princess Torosso and is rejected. Consumed by pride, he borrows the power of darkness, invades the kingdom, and takes the princess to a cursed prison island.
A young wizard of light, bound to the princess by love, guilt, and duty, crosses the sea alone.
Now it is time to cut off the fate of darkness with your own hands.

characters.name: Haeon
characters.body: A wandering wizard of the bloodline of light. He fights with a staff and the Dawn Sigil stone — never a sword.

characters.name: Princess Torosso
characters.body: Princess of a small kingdom and heir to the line that guards the seal. In a crisis, she thinks of her people first.

characters.name: Dark Knight
characters.body: The imperial prince who took the power of darkness. What he became, you will find on the prison island.

leaderboard.h2: How fast can you rescue Princess Torosso?
leaderboard.body: Finish the game and your clear time goes on the Steam leaderboard. Run it again — tighten your route, cut the mistakes, and chase the fastest rescue.
leaderboard.note_coming: The leaderboard opens with the full release.

demo.h2: Play the free demo on Steam now.
demo.lead: Liked it? Wishlist the full game to get notified at launch.
demo.lead_released: Try the demo first, then carry on into the full game.

rows.platform_v: PC Windows · Steam first, then STOVE

studio.body: KOKOPAZU STUDIO is a one-person independent game studio built around a simple question: does an adventure game always need complex skill trees and weapon combinations? Its first title, Save Princess Torosso, combines intuitive progression and ranged magic combat with platform traversal — one continuous adventure you can stay immersed in until the ending.
